summary: Validated the Anexos permission matrix on /historical-quotes (HistoricalAnexosModal) and ran a regression on /quotes (AnexosModal). ADMIN flow fully PASS end-to-end (open modal, see 6 uploads + downloads + papelera, upload .txt to 'Otros', delete via papelera, counts return to original). REGRESSION /quotes admin PASS (177 anexos buttons, modal opens with 5 uploads + 1 delete + 1 download, closes cleanly, no real console errors). CONSULTA flow FAIL at entry-point level: srubio CAN access /historical-quotes (99 rows visible) but the row-level 'Anexos' button (data-testid qh-anexos-*) is gated by isAdmin in HistoricalQuotes.jsx line 237, so srubio cannot open HistoricalAnexosModal AT ALL → cannot 'ver el listado de anexos y botones de descarga' as required by the matrix. The HistoricalAnexosModal component itself correctly gates Subir behind canEdit and Papelera behind isAdmin (lines 52-54), but the modal is unreachable for Consulta.

ui_bugs.issue: Row-level Anexos button is gated by isAdmin (only admins see it). The strict permission matrix requires Consulta (quote_history=read) users to OPEN the modal so they can view the attachment list and download files. Today, srubio (quote_history=read) sees 0 qh-anexos-* buttons → modal unreachable → cannot download attachments from the UI.

action_items: FIX HistoricalQuotes.jsx line 237: change `{isAdmin && (...)}` to show the qh-anexos-* button for any user with quote_history>=read (i.e., always show it when permission is at least read). The strict gating already lives inside HistoricalAnexosModal (canUpload via canEdit, canDelete via isAdmin). Recommended: `{(canRead || isAdmin) && (...)}` using usePermission('quote_history'). The title hint 'Anexos del histórico (solo administradores)' should also be updated to a neutral 'Anexos del histórico'.
After fix: re-test with srubio that (i) qh-anexos-* button appears in each row, (ii) modal opens, (iii) downloads visible, (iv) NO hist-anexo-upload-btn-*, (v) NO hist-anexo-delete-*.
critical_code_review_comments: HistoricalAnexosModal.jsx (lines 52-54): permission derivation is correct — canUpload=canEdit, canDelete=isAdmin via usePermission('quote_history'). Internal modal gating is sound.

HistoricalQuotes.jsx (lines 237-247): The entry point to HistoricalAnexosModal is hardcoded `{isAdmin && (...)}`. This contradicts the matrix (Consulta should at least see download view). Mismatch between page-level gate (admin-only) and component-level gate (3 tiers).
HistoricalQuotes.jsx (lines 248-259): qh-delete-* (depurar registro) IS correctly admin-only — that one should remain. Only qh-anexos-* gating needs relaxation.

Hydration warnings ('<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>', '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>') are produced by injected data-ve-dynamic wrappers (instrumentation/preview tooling) — NOT business code. Pre-existing, unrelated, non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: Admin /historical-quotes 100%, /quotes regression 100%, Consulta /historical-quotes 0% (blocked by admin-only row button)

context_for_next_testing_agent: STATE AS OF ITERATION 93: (1) Admin full cycle on /historical-quotes anexos VERIFIED — works perfectly. (2) Regression /quotes admin anexos VERIFIED — works. (3) BUG FOUND: HistoricalQuotes.jsx line 237 wraps the qh-anexos-* button in `{isAdmin && (...)}`, preventing Consulta users from opening HistoricalAnexosModal. Main agent should relax that gate to canRead||isAdmin (using usePermission('quote_history')). After the fix, retest with srubio: (a) /historical-quotes loads, (b) qh-anexos-* visible on rows, (c) clicking opens [data-testid=historical-anexos-modal], (d) inside modal: hist-anexo-download-* visible, hist-anexo-upload-btn-* COUNT must be 0, hist-anexo-delete-* COUNT must be 0. Also verify the modal title hint is neutral (currently says 'solo administradores'). Backend layer is already correct per pytest 11/11.
rca of the issue: Root cause: A previous iteration restricted the anexos row-button to admins only (presumably when only admins could upload to historical). When the new strict 3-tier matrix was introduced (Consulta=download, Edición=upload, Admin=delete), the modal's internal gates were updated correctly but the page-level entry point was not relaxed. Reproduction: login as srubio/Test1234! → /historical-quotes → inspect rows → no qh-anexos-* present (0/99). Mitigation: in HistoricalQuotes.jsx, replace the `{isAdmin && (...)}` wrapper around the FolderOpen button with a permission-aware gate using usePermission('quote_history').canRead (and update the tooltip text). The HistoricalAnexosModal already enforces the matrix internally so no further changes needed inside the modal.
